target.description: The target argument as given: a component source plugin ID, a component ID, or a component ID and version separated by `@`.

revisions.description: Which content entity revisions were searched. Config entities and auto-saves are always searched.

usages.description: One entry per place a component version is used.

kind.description: Where the usage was found: a content entity revision, a config entity, or an auto-save.

entity_type.description: Entity type ID of the entity using the component.

revision.description: Revision ID. Null for config and auto-save usages, and for non-revisionable content entities.

default.description: Whether the revision is the default revision. Null when `revision` is null.

latest.description: Whether the revision is the latest revision. Null when `revision` is null.

label.description: Entity label. For an auto-save usage, the label from the auto-save.
